base.note: Not constructible as a byte image: a validated map needs contiguous epochs from ordinal 0 (Sections 9.2, 10.1.5), and with S*k < 2^32 (Section 6.6) reaching start = 2^64 - 2 needs more than 2^32 sidecar rows.

blocker_reason: The vector exists only at unit level, and its outcome depends on the evaluation form. The text must say whether peer classification is computed in ordinal space.
evaluation: Peer of the stripe-0 shard at data_index 1: o = (2^64 - 2) + 1*2 + 0 = 2^64, which overflows. That peer is an implicit zero (ordinal >= end), so its exact value is never needed.

expected.permitting_text: Section 2.4 makes the overflow a rejection, but a Recoverer that tests data_index·S + stripe >= real_data_shard_count in epoch-relative space never overflows and recovers the block. Section 13.4 states the implicit-zero test as 'an ordinal ≥ protected_ordinal_end_exclusive'.

pin_reason: Two conformant evaluation forms reach different outcomes on the same descriptor, and a wrapped value (to 0) would silently name a real ordinal.
quotes: **Implicit zero**: an ordinal ≥ `protected_ordinal_end_exclusive` — an all-zero shard supplied without tape I/O; not an erasure (Section 6.4).
target: the Recoverer gathering stripe peers and classifying implicit zeros (Sections 13.4, 6.4)
